title: Inter extend Carlos Augusto to 2031, Bastoni has scans today
caption:
Inter have extended Carlos Augusto's contract until June 30, 2031, per Inter.it. Two Serie A titles in, he stays. La Gazzetta dello Sport reports that Bastoni has scans today on a sore thigh, and his place against Genoa on Saturday is still open. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
